title: FREE REQUEST Looking for rmmz or mv co developer!

posts.author: rhinosoup
posts.body:
Hello! I’m looking for assistance or a co-developer for my game Hypocrite! I’ve got all the art covered (no stress there), but I’m still figuring out the gameplay systems, plugin ideas, and code side of things. I’m looking for a coder, kind of like how games like Dead Plate came together with a strong creative trio. I’d love to meet other devs, collaborate, become friends, and build something meaningful together! The game might end up in my portfolio (mostly for the art direction), so it would be great if that’s something you’re cool with. You can find the demo in my older threads, but a lot will change, here’s just one concept screenshot to show the vibe!
I speak both Mandarin and English, and while I’m not a pro coder, I can help out a bit with scripts if needed. I have RPG Maker MZ and MV, but the current build is in MZ, that said, I’m happy to work with MV devs (demo is made in MV) too! Story-wise, it’s still evolving, but it’s focused on doppelgängers, cults, and the search for identity. The lore/worldbuilding is still flexible, so feel free to bring your ideas in too! I really admire games like 8:11 that have longer, meaningful gameplay, and I’d love Hypocrite to reach that kind of playtime and emotional impact.

Hello! Not sure if you’re still interested in working on Hypocrite. We’re currently a team of two, planning to eventually publish the game on Steam. I handle the art, a bit of music, and the storyline, while Temi works on the coding. For payment and other details, we can talk more on Discord!
If you’re not looking to work with another coder, I’m also starting a smaller project that could use some coding help. It’s an escape room style game centered around the concept of red rooms, so it’ll have some gore. The idea is super fresh, I just started it this week, and there are some game mechanics I’d like to explore. If you’re interested, we can definitely figure it out together.
If neither project sounds like your thing but you’re still down to collab on something else, feel free to hit me up! I’m open to other ideas too. Let me know if you’re interested!
